grammar: n. 不可数，表示乐趣；adj. 非正式地表示有趣的、令人愉快的。作名词时常用于 have fun。
collocations: have fun; a lot of fun; for fun; fun activities; a fun day。
commonMistake: 表示“好玩、有趣”通常用 fun；funny 多表示“好笑的”或“奇怪的”。

example.english: We have fun in the garden after lunch.
example.chinese: 午饭后我们在花园里玩得很开心。

application.prompt: We had ___ at the school fair. A. fun B. funny
application.solution: A。解析：此处表示玩得开心，用不可数名词 fun；funny 表示好笑或奇怪。

grammar: n. 可数名词，复数 yards；本单元指房屋旁或周围的院子。yard 也可表示长度单位“码”，需结合语境判断。
collocations: in the yard; front/back yard; play in the yard; a small yard。
commonMistake: yard 有“院子”和“码”两种常见词义，注意结合前后文判断。

example.english: The dog is playing in the yard.
example.chinese: 狗正在院子里玩。

application.prompt: There are flowers and a small tree ___ our yard. A. in B. from
application.solution: A。解析：表示在院子里面用 in the yard。

grammar: carrot 是可数名词，复数为 carrots；在 carrot soup 等复合名词中，carrot 作前置修饰语时通常用单数形式。
collocations: a carrot; carrot sticks; carrot soup; grow carrots。
commonMistake: 表示胡萝卜本身时按可数名词使用：a carrot、two carrots；carrot soup 中单数形式 carrot 是复合名词的前置修饰语。

example.english: The rabbit is eating a carrot.
example.chinese: 兔子正在吃一根胡萝卜。

application.prompt: There are four ___ in this basket. A. carrot B. carrots
application.solution: B。解析：four 后接可数名词复数 carrots。

grammar: n. 可数名词，指鹅；复数是不规则形式 geese。
collocations: a goose; two geese; a goose in the yard。
commonMistake: goose 的复数是 geese，不是 gooses。

example.english: A goose is walking beside the pond.
example.chinese: 一只鹅正在池塘边走。

application.prompt: One goose, two ___. A. gooses B. geese
application.solution: B。解析：goose 的不规则复数形式为 geese。

grammar: v. count—counted—counted，第三人称单数 counts，现在分词 counting；可表示依次数数或计算数量。
collocations: count to ten; count the animals; count how many; count the books。
commonMistake: can、may 等情态动词后接动词原形 count；主语为 he/she/it 时一般现在时用 counts。

example.english: Can you count the carrots in the basket?
example.chinese: 你能数一数篮子里的胡萝卜吗？

application.prompt: Our teacher asks us to ___ the plants in the yard. A. count B. counts
application.solution: A。解析：to 后接动词原形 count。

grammar: det./pron. 表示“另一个、再一个”；作限定词时 another + 单数可数名词，也可独立作代词。
collocations: another book; another one; another day; one another。
commonMistake: another 通常不直接修饰复数名词；说“其他的书”用 other books，说“再一本书”用 another book。

example.english: Please bring another chair from the kitchen.
example.chinese: 请从厨房再拿一把椅子来。

application.prompt: We need ___ plant for the yard. A. another B. else
application.solution: A。解析：名词 plant 前表示“再一株”用 another；else 通常放在疑问词或不定代词后。

grammar: adv. 表示“其他的、另外的”；常放在 someone、anything、where、what 等词之后。
collocations: someone else; anything else; what else; where else。
commonMistake: else 通常后置，如 something else、who else；不要说 else something。

example.english: Is there anything else in the box?
example.chinese: 盒子里还有别的东西吗？

application.prompt: What ___ do we need for the garden? A. else B. other
application.solution: A。解析：else 放在疑问词 what 后表示“还有什么”。

grammar: v. circle—circled—circled，表示用线圈出；n. 可数名词，复数 circles，表示圆圈。
collocations: circle the answer/word; draw a circle; in a circle。
commonMistake: 作动词表示“圈出”时可直接接对象，如 circle the answer，不必加 around。

example.english: Circle the two rabbits in the picture.
example.chinese: 把图中的两只兔子圈出来。

application.prompt: Please ___ the carrot in the picture. A. circle B. circles
application.solution: A。解析：祈使句用动词原形 circle。

grammar: cat 是可数名词，复数为 cats；常指家猫，也可泛指猫科动物中的猫。
collocations: a pet cat; feed the cat; cat food; a cat and a dog。
commonMistake: cat 作单数可数名词时，通常需有 a、the、my 等限定词。

example.english: The black cat is sitting by the plant.
example.chinese: 那只黑猫正坐在植物旁边。

application.prompt: I have ___ small cat at home. A. a B. an
application.solution: A。解析：small 以辅音音素开头，单数可数名词短语前用 a。

grammar: det./pron. this 的复数，指说话者附近的多个人或物；作限定词时 these + 复数名词，独立作主语时通常搭配 are。
collocations: these books/plants; these are; one of these; look at these。
commonMistake: these 指复数，后接复数名词或单独使用；单数对应 this。

example.english: These carrots are for the rabbits.
example.chinese: 这些胡萝卜是给兔子的。

application.prompt: ___ are my new plants. A. These B. This
application.solution: A。解析：plants 是复数，指示代词用 these；谓语 are 也与复数一致。

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: this, that, these, those

grammar: n. 可数名词，复数 plants，表示植物；v. plant—planted—planted，现在分词 planting，表示种植。
collocations: a plant; tomato plant; plant seeds/trees/flowers; plant something in the garden。
commonMistake: plant 作动词表示种植时直接接种子或植物，如 plant seeds；情态动词后用原形 plant。

example.english: We plant tomato seeds in the yard each spring.
example.chinese: 每年春天我们都在院子里种番茄种子。

application.prompt: We want to ___ tomatoes in the yard. A. plant B. plants
application.solution: A。解析：want to 后接动词原形 plant。

grammar: n. 可数名词，可指婴儿或动物幼崽；复数 babies。
collocations: a baby rabbit; baby animals; a baby bird; have a baby。
commonMistake: baby 的复数拼作 babies：辅音字母加 y 结尾，变 y 为 i 再加 -es。

example.english: The baby rabbit is hiding near its mother.
example.chinese: 小兔子正躲在妈妈附近。

application.prompt: A rabbit has two ___. (baby)
application.solution: babies。解析：baby 以辅音字母加 y 结尾，复数变 y 为 i 再加 -es。

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: forming the plural of nouns

examTags: 语法·可数与不可数名词
grammar: n. 表示农场饲养的鸡时可数，复数 chickens；表示鸡肉时常作不可数名词。
collocations: a chicken; two chickens; chicken for lunch; chicken soup。
commonMistake: chicken 可指鸡也可指鸡肉；表示一只鸡时常用 a chicken，泛指食物时常用 chicken。

example.english: There are three chickens in the yard, and we have chicken for lunch.
example.chinese: 院子里有三只鸡，我们午饭吃鸡肉。

application.prompt: There are two ___ near the plant. A. chicken B. chickens
application.solution: B。解析：two 后接可数名词复数；此处说两只鸡。

grammar: n. 可数名词，复数 dogs；常指宠物狗，也可指用于看护或狩猎的狗。
collocations: a pet dog; walk the dog; dog food; dogs bark。
commonMistake: 表示不止一只狗时用 dogs；普通单数 dog 前需有冠词或其他限定词。

example.english: Our dog follows the children around the yard.
example.chinese: 我们的狗跟着孩子们在院子里走来走去。

application.prompt: The two ___ are playing with a ball. A. dog B. dogs
application.solution: B。解析：two 后接可数名词复数 dogs。

grammar: n. 可数名词，复数 rabbits；也可指兔肉，此时可作不可数名词。
collocations: a pet rabbit; two rabbits; feed a rabbit; a rabbit in the yard。
commonMistake: rabbit 作单数可数名词时通常要有 a、the、my 等限定词。

example.english: The rabbit hops past the tomato plants.
example.chinese: 兔子跳过番茄植株旁边。

application.prompt: We can see three ___ in the yard. A. rabbit B. rabbits
application.solution: B。解析：three 后接可数名词复数 rabbits。

grammar: tomato 是可数名词，复数为 tomatoes；在 tomato soup、tomato plant 等复合名词中，tomato 作前置修饰语时通常用单数形式。
collocations: a tomato; two tomatoes; tomato soup; tomato plant。
commonMistake: tomato 的复数是 tomatoes；部分以 o 结尾的名词复数需加 -es。

example.english: These tomatoes came from our garden.
example.chinese: 这些西红柿是我们从花园里摘的。

application.prompt: Please put the three ___ in the basket. A. tomato B. tomatoes
application.solution: B。解析：three 后接名词复数；tomato 的复数拼作 tomatoes。

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: forming the plural of nouns

grammar: flower 是可数名词，单数前可用 a，复数为 flowers。
collocations: a flower; pick a flower; a bunch of flowers; flower garden
commonMistake: 复数要在 flower 后加 -s；flower“花”和 flour“面粉”读音相同，拼写和意思不同。

example.english: We put a yellow flower by the window.
example.chinese: 我们在窗边放了一朵黄色的花。

application.prompt: 选词填空：There is a ___ in the vase. A. flower  B. flowers
application.solution: A. flower。a 后接可数名词单数。

grammar: apple 是可数名词，单数前用 an，复数为 apples。
collocations: an apple; apple tree; apple juice; pick an apple
commonMistake: apple 以元音音素开头，单数前用 an apple；复数 apples 前不加 a/an。

example.english: I picked an apple from the tree.
example.chinese: 我从树上摘了一个苹果。

application.prompt: 选词填空：I eat ___ apple after lunch. A. an  B. a
application.solution: A. an。apple 以元音音素开头，前面用 an。

grammar: tree 是可数名词，复数为 trees；常用 under/in a tree 表示在树下/树上。
collocations: plant a tree; climb a tree; under a tree; an apple tree
commonMistake: tree 的复数是 trees；表示树上长着或住着的东西常用 in the tree，表示落在树下常用 under the tree。

example.english: A small bird is in the tree.
example.chinese: 树上有一只小鸟。

application.prompt: There are two ___ by the lake. A. tree  B. trees
application.solution: B. trees。two 后接可数名词复数，tree 的复数形式是 trees。

grammar: this 可作指示代词独立指代离说话者较近的单数人或物；也可放在单数名词前作限定词。
collocations: this is; this one; this apple; this tree
commonMistake: this 指单数，be 动词通常用 is；指复数时用 these。

example.english: This is my apple.
example.chinese: 这是我的苹果。

application.prompt: 你手里拿着一个苹果，说：___ is red. A. This  B. These
application.solution: A. This。指近处的一个苹果用 this；these 用于近处的复数人或物。

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: This, that, these, those

grammar: those 可作指示代词，独立指代离说话者较远的复数人或物；也可放在复数名词前作限定词。
collocations: those are; those animals; those ducks; those trees over there
commonMistake: those 用于远处的复数人或物；that 用于远处的单数人或物。

example.english: Those are my grandpa’s ducks.
example.chinese: 那些是我爷爷/外公的鸭子。

application.prompt: 那边湖上的三只鸭子饿了。___ need some food. A. Those  B. That
application.solution: A. Those。三只鸭子是远处的复数事物，用 those；that 用于远处的单数事物。

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: This, that, these, those

grammar: animal 是可数名词，复数为 animals；单数前用 an。
collocations: a wild animal; a farm animal; love animals; many animals
commonMistake: animal 虽以字母 a 开头，但选择 a/an 看发音；它以元音音素开头，所以说 an animal。

example.english: A horse is a large farm animal.
example.chinese: 马是一种大型农场动物。

application.prompt: 选词填空：A cow is ___ animal. A. an  B. a
application.solution: A. an。animal 以元音音素开头，单数前用 an。

grammar: duck 作“鸭子”时是可数名词，复数为 ducks。
collocations: a duck; a duck pond; feed the ducks; a mother duck
commonMistake: 表示两只或多只鸭子时用 ducks；不要漏掉复数词尾 -s。

example.english: The yellow duck is swimming in the lake.
example.chinese: 那只黄色的鸭子正在湖里游泳。

application.prompt: 选词填空：Look at the two ___. A. duck  B. ducks
application.solution: B. ducks。two 后接可数名词复数。

grammar: potato 作“土豆”时是可数名词，复数拼写为 potatoes。
collocations: a potato; baked potatoes; mashed potato; potato salad
commonMistake: potato 的复数通常写 potatoes，不是 potatos；注意把词尾 o 改为 oes。

example.english: We need two potatoes for dinner.
example.chinese: 晚饭我们需要两个土豆。

application.prompt: 选词填空：There are three ___ in the bag. A. potato  B. potatoes
application.solution: B. potatoes。three 后接复数；potato 的复数是 potatoes。

grammar: many 可作限定词修饰可数名词复数，也可作代词单独使用；常见问法是 How many + 复数名词。
collocations: how many animals; many ducks; too many apples; so many cows
commonMistake: many 修饰可数名词复数；much 常修饰不可数名词。回答数量时可单独用 many，如 There are many。

example.english: How many cows are on the farm? There are many.
example.chinese: 农场有多少头奶牛？有很多。

application.prompt: 选词填空：How ___ animals are on the farm? A. many  B. much
application.solution: A. many。animals 是可数名词复数，询问数量用 how many。

grammar: grandpa 是 grandfather 的非正式说法，是可数名词；用作直接称呼时常大写 Grandpa。
collocations: my grandpa; visit Grandpa; Grandpa’s farm; Grandma and Grandpa
commonMistake: my grandpa 中 grandpa 通常小写；直接称呼时首字母大写，如 Hello, Grandpa! 英语的 grandpa 不区分爷爷和外公。

example.english: My grandpa has a small farm.
example.chinese: 我爷爷/外公有一个小农场。

application.prompt: 选出直接称呼时合适的写法：Good morning, ___! A. Grandpa  B. grandpa
application.solution: A. Grandpa。直接称呼家人时称呼语首字母通常大写。

grammar: farm 作“农场”时是可数名词，单数前常用 a，复数为 farms；常用 on a farm 表示在农场。
collocations: on a farm; farm animals; work on a farm; a dairy farm
commonMistake: farm 是可数名词，单数前通常需要限定词，如 a farm 或 my farm；表示在农场常说 on a farm。

example.english: There are many animals on the farm.
example.chinese: 农场里有许多动物。

application.prompt: 选出表示“农场”的词：We can see cows, ducks, and horses on the ___. A. farm  B. lake
application.solution: A. farm。奶牛、鸭子和马生活在农场语境中。

grammar: cow 是可数名词，指奶牛时单数前可用 a，复数为 cows。
collocations: a cow; dairy cow; cow’s milk; feed the cows
commonMistake: a cow 表示一头奶牛，复数 cows 表示多头；不要把复数写成 cow’s，后者通常表示“奶牛的”。

example.english: The cow is eating grass near the tree.
example.chinese: 奶牛正在树旁吃草。

application.prompt: 选词填空：There are two ___ near the house. A. cow  B. cows
application.solution: B. cows。two 后接可数名词复数。

grammar: small 是形容词，可放在名词前或 be 动词后；比较级 smaller，最高级 smallest。
collocations: a small house; a small animal; smaller than; the smallest apple
commonMistake: small 的比较级和最高级要双写 l 再加 -er/-est：smaller、smallest；than 前通常用比较级。

example.english: This is a small apple.
example.chinese: 这是一个小苹果。

application.prompt: 选词填空：The duck is ___ than the cow. A. smaller  B. small
application.solution: A. smaller。than 表示比较，small 要用比较级 smaller。

grammar: lake 是可数名词，单数前可用 a，复数为 lakes；常见位置表达有 by the lake、on the lake。
collocations: by the lake; on the lake; a lake; a small lake
commonMistake: lake 是可数名词，单数前要有冠词或其他限定词，如 a lake、the lake。

example.english: Those ducks are swimming in the lake.
example.chinese: 那些鸭子正在湖里游泳。

application.prompt: 选出合适的地点：The ducks are swimming in the ___. A. lake  B. house
application.solution: A. lake。鸭子在湖里游泳，地点语境对应 lake。

grammar: house 是可数名词，指房屋建筑，单数前常用 a，复数为 houses。
collocations: a small house; my house; in the house; a house by the lake
commonMistake: house 侧重房屋建筑，home 侧重居住的家；表达“回家”用 go home，不说 go to home。

example.english: Grandpa’s house is next to the lake.
example.chinese: 爷爷/外公的房子在湖边。

application.prompt: 选词填空：The family lives in a small ___. A. house  B. horse
application.solution: A. house。家人居住的建筑是 house；horse 是“马”。

grammar: horse 是可数名词，单数前可用 a，复数为 horses。
collocations: a horse; ride a horse; a horse and cart; a brown horse
commonMistake: horse 是“马”，house 是“房子”；注意拼写和词义不同。

example.english: The brown horse is behind the house.
example.chinese: 那匹棕色的马在房子后面。

application.prompt: 选词填空：The farmer rides a ___. A. horse  B. house
application.solution: A. horse。农夫骑的是马；house 表示房子。

grammar: sheep 表示绵羊时，单数和复数同形：one sheep, three sheep。句中谓语根据实际数量确定。
collocations: a sheep; three sheep; a flock of sheep; sheep on the farm
commonMistake: sheep 的复数不加 -s；表示三只羊说 three sheep，不说 three sheeps。

example.english: There are five sheep behind the house.
example.chinese: 房子后面有五只绵羊。

application.prompt: There are two ___ on the farm. A. sheep  B. sheeps
application.solution: A. sheep。sheep 的单复数同形，two 后仍用 sheep。

grammar: big 作形容词表示“大”；比较级 bigger，最高级 biggest。变比较级、最高级时通常双写词尾 g 再加 -er/-est。
collocations: a big house; a big animal; big and small; get bigger
commonMistake: big 的比较级和最高级要双写 g：bigger, biggest；不说 more big。

example.english: The brown horse is bigger than the white one.
example.chinese: 这匹棕色的马比那匹白色的马大。

application.prompt: This cow is ___ than that one. A. bigger  B. big
application.solution: A. bigger。than 表示比较，big 要用比较级 bigger。

grammar: look 作“看”时常用 look at + 人或物；look 也可作连系动词，后接形容词描述看起来的状态，如 look happy。
collocations: look at a picture; look for a book; look after an animal; look happy
commonMistake: 表示“看某物”时用 look at，不说 look the picture；look 后接形容词描述状态，不用副词替代。

example.english: Look at the sheep near the lake.
example.chinese: 看湖边的那些绵羊。

application.prompt: Please look ___ the picture of my farm. A. at  B. on
application.solution: A. at。look at 表示“看……”；picture 前用 at 引出对象。

grammar: uncle 是可数名词，复数为 uncles。英语 uncle 可泛指父母的男性兄弟，也可指父母的男性姻亲。
collocations: my uncle; Uncle Wang; an uncle and an aunt; visit my uncle
commonMistake: 普通叙述中说 my uncle；直接称呼并接姓名时常写作 Uncle Wang，称呼语首字母大写。

example.english: My uncle has a small farm.
example.chinese: 我叔叔有一个小农场。

application.prompt: My father's brother is my ___. A. uncle  B. aunt
application.solution: A. uncle。uncle 表示叔叔、伯伯或舅舅等男性亲属。

grammar: grass 通常作不可数名词表示“草”，泛指时不加 a，通常也不变复数；表达一根草可说 a blade of grass。
collocations: green grass; walk on the grass; cut the grass; a blade of grass
commonMistake: 表示草地上的草时通常说 grass，不说 a grass 或 grasses；grass 也可指草坪上的草。

example.english: The sheep are eating grass in the yard.
example.chinese: 绵羊正在院子里吃草。

application.prompt: The cow is eating ___. A. grass  B. a grass
application.solution: A. grass。grass 在这里泛指草，是不可数名词，不用 a。

grammar: kind 作名词表示“种类”，常见结构为 a kind of + 名词；作形容词表示“体贴的、亲切的”，常用 be kind to sb。
collocations: a kind of animal; different kinds of flowers; be kind to animals; a kind person
commonMistake: 表示“对某人/某物友好”说 be kind to；many kinds of 后接名词复数，如 many kinds of animals。

example.english: My grandpa is kind to all the animals on his farm.
example.chinese: 我爷爷对农场里的所有动物都很友善。

application.prompt: She is always kind ___ the little dog. A. to  B. at
application.solution: A. to。固定搭配 be kind to sb/sth 表示“对……友好”。

grammar: he 是第三人称单数男性人称代词主格，常在句中作主语；动词一般现在时通常要用第三人称单数形式。
collocations: he is; he has; he likes; he and his family
commonMistake: he 作主语，动词或介词后的宾语用 him，表示“他的”用 his：He likes his farm. I visit him.

example.english: He looks after the animals every morning.
example.chinese: 他每天早上照看这些动物。

application.prompt: ___ is my uncle. A. He  B. Him
application.solution: A. He。空格处作句子主语，要用人称代词主格。

grammar: pig 是可数名词，复数为 pigs；表示一只猪用 a pig，表示多只猪用 pigs。
collocations: a pig; two pigs; a pig farm; feed the pigs
commonMistake: pig 的复数直接加 -s：pigs；数词 two 后用复数，不说 two pig。

example.english: The pig is in the yard with the dog.
example.chinese: 猪和狗在院子里。

application.prompt: I can see three ___ behind the house. A. pig  B. pigs
application.solution: B. pigs。three 后接可数名词复数，pig 的复数加 -s。

grammar: there 可作地点副词表示“在那里”；there be 句型表示某处有某人或某物，be 动词根据后面的名词决定单复数。
collocations: over there; there is a cow; there are two ducks; Is there…?
commonMistake: there 表示地点；their 表示“他们的”；they're 是 they are 的缩写。There is 后接单数名词，there are 后接复数名词。

example.english: There are two ducks by the lake.
example.chinese: 湖边有两只鸭子。

application.prompt: There ___ a cow behind the house. A. is  B. are
application.solution: A. is。there be 句型中，a cow 是单数，be 动词用 is。

grammar: behind 可作介词表示“在……后面”，后接名词或代词；也可作副词表示“在后面”。
collocations: behind the house; behind a tree; stand behind me; behind the door
commonMistake: behind 后直接接地点或人，不加 of：behind the house，不说 behind of the house。

example.english: The cat is hiding behind the chair.
example.chinese: 猫藏在椅子后面。

application.prompt: The dog is in front of the house; the pig is ___ it. A. behind  B. under
application.solution: A. behind。句意与 in front of（在前面）相对，猪在房子后面。

grammar: home 作名词表示“家”；在 go, come, get 等移动动词后常作副词，表示回家或到家，前面不加 to。
collocations: at home; go home; come home; get home; a happy home
commonMistake: 表示“回家”说 go home，不说 go to home；house 通常指建筑物，home 更强调居住和生活的地方。

example.english: My family and I are at home today.
example.chinese: 我和家人今天在家。

application.prompt: After school, I go ___. A. home  B. to home
application.solution: A. home。home 在 go 后作地点副词时不加 to。

grammar: beautiful 是形容词，常放在名词前作定语，也可放在 be 动词后作表语；比较级和最高级通常用 more/most beautiful。
collocations: a beautiful flower; a beautiful house; look beautiful; more beautiful
commonMistake: beautiful 的比较级和最高级通常说 more beautiful、most beautiful，不说 beautifuler、beautifulest；名词形式是 beauty。

example.english: There is a beautiful flower by the lake.
example.chinese: 湖边有一朵美丽的花。

application.prompt: The garden looks ___. A. beautiful  B. beauty
application.solution: A. beautiful。look 在这里是连系动词，后接形容词说明花园的状态。

grammar: like 作动词表示“喜欢”，后接名词、动名词或 to do；主语为 he/she/it 时用 likes。like 也可作介词表示“像……一样”或举例。
collocations: like animals; like doing sth; like to do sth; animals like cows and sheep
commonMistake: 一般现在时主语是 he/she/it 时用 likes；表示“像”时 like 是介词，后接名词短语，如 It looks like a horse.

example.english: I like the animals on my grandpa's farm.
example.chinese: 我喜欢爷爷农场里的动物。

application.prompt: My uncle ___ the horse. A. likes  B. like
application.solution: A. likes。主语 my uncle 是第三人称单数，一般现在时谓语动词用 likes。

examTags: 语法·物主限定词与代词
grammar: his 可作物主限定词，放在名词前表示“他的”；也可单独作名词性物主代词，表示“他的（东西）”。
collocations: his house; his family; his animals; The book is his.
commonMistake: his 前不加撇号，也不写成 his's；his 后接名词时表示“他的”，单独使用时可指“他的东西”。

example.english: The big house is his.
example.chinese: 那座大房子是他的。

application.prompt: Look at the boy. ___ name is Tom. A. His  B. He
application.solution: A. His。空格后有名词 name，应使用物主限定词 his。

examTags: 语言运用·常见介词搭配
grammar: at 常用于较具体的地点或准确时刻，如 at the farm、at home、at seven o'clock；也常见于 look at 等搭配。
collocations: at home; at school; at the farm; at 7:00; look at a picture
commonMistake: 表示准确钟点通常用 at；表示一天中的某段时间通常用 in（如 in the morning），表示具体某一天常用 on。

example.english: The horses are at the farm.
example.chinese: 这些马在农场里。

application.prompt: My uncle gets up ___ seven o'clock. A. at  B. in
application.solution: A. at。具体钟点前通常用 at。
